sources.author: Cicero
sources.coverage_notes: Selected-works authority with broad principal-work coverage: 119 registered edition bodies after the 2026-09-06 batch. Latin main speech collections, rhetorical/philosophical works and four correspondence collections represented; Shuckburgh English correspondence files include splits and overlaps, so encoded letter counts are not unique-letter completeness. De Legibus has all three surviving books in a digital transcription with unidentified underlying print edition. Hortensius and De consulatu suo are fragments; Epistula ad Octavianum is pseudo-attributed. Remaining gaps include comprehensive poetic, speech and philosophical fragments (including Aratea, Consolatio, lost-work testimonia), disputed corpus edges and a complete cross-edition letter concordance. Retain selected-works; do not infer author completeness from body counts.
sources.date_label: 1st c. BCE
